title: TCA Protein Extraction from Diatoms
author: Anna Santin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc7rizm6

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Obtain a pellet from approximately 50 ml of culture in exponential phase (containing 2 million cells).

steps.title: Wash Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 1 ml of 20% TCA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the pellet in 100 µl of 20% TCA and perform mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add glass beads up to the meniscus

steps.title: Clarify Protein Extract
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant from the cell debris.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Prepare Protein Sample
steps.instruction: Add buffers to the clarified extract and dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Quickly add 100 µl of 3X SDS Laemmli Buffer and vortex thoroughly to dissolve
Add 50 µl Tris Base and vortex thoroughly to dissolve

steps.title: Final Protein Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform a final centrifugation to recover the protein supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes
Transfer the protein-containing supernatant into a new Eppendorf tube
Pour off the remaining supernatant by aspiration
